Yes — several papers match this area. The closest are papers on topic modeling via clustering and LLM-guided topic organization: TriTopic uses a tri-modal graph with consensus clustering and iterative refinement for topic modeling [2], while ClusterFusion uses embedding-guided partitioning plus LLM-driven topic summarization and assignment [1]. Iterative Topic Taxonomy Induction also combines embedding-based clustering with iterative LLM inference to build a topic taxonomy from unlabeled text [4].

If you mean community clustering specifically, A Community-Based Approach for Stance Distribution and Argument Organization uses graph-based community detection to organize argumentative content, but it is aimed at argument communities rather than topic models [7].
